title: Weeping and Tears
summary: Weeping was a common public response to grief, repentance, intercession, and deep distress.
background: Biblical weeping can be personal, communal, or prophetic. It often reveals the seriousness of sin, suffering, loss, or longing for restoration.
teachingHelp: Do not rush past tears. Ask what the grief reveals and how God meets His people in sorrow.
